fields.name: Length of generic message container contents
fields.description: Length of the container contents in octets

fields.name: Generic message container contents
fields.description: Generic message container contents (octet 4 to octet n); Max value of 65535 octets. The coding of the contents of the generic message container is dependent on the particular application.

notes: The generic message container is a type 6 information element.
This information element is used to encapsulate the application message transferred between the UE and the network.
